title: Introduction to Webhook security
text:
What is Webhook security?

To secure a webhook you validate the signature Kontent.ai sends so you can trust the webhook payload came from us.

  • Verify the X-KC-Signature header on every webhook request
  • Compute an HMAC-SHA256 hash with your secret to secure the webhook
  • Reject any webhook whose signature does not match
  • Always receive webhooks over a secure HTTPS endpoint

Keywords: webhook, secure, security, signature, hmac, secret, validate.

const hash = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(body).digest("base64");

This overview of Webhook security helps you understand where it fits in a Kontent.ai project.
